# Vendored dependency

GridStack 14.0.0 (MIT). Standard library used for collision handling, drag, resize, responsive grid layout and serialization.

- Source: https://github.com/gridstack/gridstack.js
- API: https://gridstackjs.com/doc/html/classes/GridStack.html
- Files: gridstack-all.js, gridstack.min.css, gridstack-LICENSE.txt
- Downloaded from the pinned npm distribution at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@14.0.0/dist/

No build step is required. SVG charts use the browser's native SVG and animation features.
